Keep those in the host."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Feature | What it does |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| **Path whitelist** | `owned_paths` in the task package is the set of paths the executor may touch."},{"id":"p12s2","text":" Changes outside it are detected and reported in `result.violations` rather than silently accepted. "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"An empty list is enforced as **additions only**, not as "no check" |
| **Failures stay collectable**"},{"id":"p12s4","text":" | If dispatch or the supervisor fails, `exit.json` and `result.json` are still written, so the job "},{"id":"p12s5","text":"arrives as `failed` with a blocker instead of vanishing. The CLI is probed before any claim is taken"},{"id":"p12s6","text":", so a missing executor leaves no live lock |
| **Directory isolation** | On a Git repository the ru"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"n happens in a dedicated worktree on a `wb-exec/<id8>` branch: no commit, no push, no auto-merge |
|"},{"id":"p12s8","text":" **Real diff first** | The executor's `summary` is only its own account. `change.patch` and `changed"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"_files_git` come from the actual `git diff`; when the two disagree, the diff wins |
| **Structured c"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"apture** | A `--json-schema` constraint forces structured output; the script then adds the git diff "},{"id":"p12s11","text":"and the out-of-scope check to produce a machine-readable `result.json` |
| **Recursion guard** | The"},{"id":"p12s12","text":" child process gets `WB_SUBAGENT=1`; the script refuses to dispatch when it sees that variable (exit"},{"id":"p12s13","text":" code 3), so an executor cannot spawn another executor |
| **Path-level dispatch lock** | A second d"},{"id":"p12s14","text":"ispatch whose `owned_paths` overlap a running job is refused (`PATHS_LOCKED`, exit code 4) instead o"},{"id":"p12s15","text":"f racing it. Disjoint paths still run in parallel. Whether a claim is still alive is decided by the "},{"id":"p12s16","text":"recorded **pid**, not by a heartbeat age: a supervisor that died before writing its first heartbeat "},{"id":"p12s17","text":"leaves no heartbeat while the executor it spawned may still be editing the claimed paths |
| **Faile"},{"id":"p12s18","text":"d-closed lock** | A `dispatch.lock` that exists but cannot be parsed is refused rather than treated "},{"id":"p12s19","text":"as "no claims". Coercing a damaged lock to empty would admit every job and then rewrite the file wit"},{"id":"p12s20","text":"h only the new claim, discarding live holds silently |
